objective: Move holyagent Intent state onto one dedicated state-only branch in a persistent shared worktree that every CLI command uses, records each Intent's branches and PRs, and always merges into or stacks with other branches without conflicts.
scope: Code background, from a source trace (verify each before relying on it): stateRoot in packages/runtime/src/cli/context.ts:21-34 and program.ts:46-52 resolve <worktree toplevel>/.holyagent, so each linked worktree has its own state; state/store.ts persist writes intents/<slug>-<id>/intent.json and assignments/*.json; local/active-intent.json and local/vcs.json are per clone and gitignored; vcs/commit.ts:54-122 stages the Intent-in-use folder into whatever branch HEAD is on; vcs/pr.ts records branch/base/PR only in local/vcs.json; the Intent schema has no branch or PR field.

Design to implement (user decision): (1) one branch, default name holyagent/state (configurable in .holyagent/config.json or git config), checked out in a persistent linked worktree shared by all worktrees of the clone (for example under the git common dir), created on first use from origin/holyagent/state when it exists, otherwise from the base branch head; (2) every holyagent command reads and writes state there whatever the cwd worktree or checked-out branch; (3) each state transition is committed locally on the state branch with the repository identity, so work trees never hold uncommitted state; no command pushes (the root pushes with plain git); (4) holyagent vcs commit stops staging .holyagent/; (5) the Intent records the branches it committed on and the PRs vcs pr opened or updated, in versioned state; (6) uncommitted or newer working-tree .holyagent records found in a work tree are migrated into the state worktree once.

Seamless-merge requirement (user, verbatim: 'it must always be easy to stack onto other branches and merge seamslessly'): the state branch changes only .holyagent/ and work branches never modify .holyagent/, so merging the state branch into any work or stack branch, and any work branch into it, never conflicts; every record is its own file with a unique id and no shared mutable index; append-only logs, if any, use a .gitattributes merge=union entry.

Ownership: packages/runtime/src/cli, packages/runtime/src/state, packages/runtime/src/vcs, packages/runtime/src/domain, packages/runtime/tests, packages/cli, .gitattributes. Instruction text, docs, AGENTS.md and the generated plugin are a later Assignment; list any of their lines your change makes wrong in the report.

notes:
- **Active Intent:** it was already described as per clone, and now it really is one file shared by all worktrees. Two sessions in different worktrees working on different Intents will share it. Say if you want it per work tree.
- **Identity:** state commits use the repository's git identity. If none is configured, or it looks like an agent's, they use a neutral `holyagent <holyagent@localhost>`, so state commits never carry agent attribution and never fail for lack of an identity. State commits skip hooks and signing.
- **Merge safety:** `vcs commit` now refuses a path under `.holyagent` (exit 2), so a work branch can never carry state.
- **Record files:**
  - Branch and pull request records are separate files in the Intent's folder, `branches/<id>.json` and `pulls/<id>.json`.
  - Each has a generated id and is never edited, so two lines of state never touch the same file.
  - `intent show` lists the branches and the latest record per PR number; an update without `--base` keeps the earlier base.
  - Recording is best effort: a failure shows as `unrecorded` in the output, and with no Intent in use nothing is written.
  - `local/vcs.json` is no longer written, but still read.
- **Creating the worktree:**
  - Only `intent create` and a real `migrate` create it unconditionally.
  - Every other command, including the hooks, creates it only if the project already has a state branch, its `origin` copy, or a `.holyagent` folder in any work tree.
  - The `commit-msg` hook never creates or migrates anything.
  - In a non-git folder the state stays in `<cwd>/.holyagent` and nothing is committed, as before.
- **Migration:** it runs once per work tree, tracked by a marker under the git directory. A file the state worktree lacks is copied. An uncommitted edit wins over the state branch's copy. After the state commit, the copied untracked files are deleted from the work tree and edited tracked files are restored to HEAD. A newly created state worktree also takes in every other work tree of the clone.
- **Existing branches:** old tracked `.holyagent/` on `main` and in-flight branches stays. The state branch starts from the base head, so it merges cleanly, but those old copies remain as history.
- **Ideas, not done:**
  - A sparse checkout would avoid a second full checkout of the repository for the state worktree.
  - `LocalChange.vcs` and `Snapshot.vcs` are now unused.
